name: wso2-identity-integration-demo
description: Flagship full-stack CIAM & OIDC PKCE visual showcase for Choreo Labs (formerly WSO2) — WSO2 Identity Server 7.0 & Asgardeo, featuring an interactive PKCE/JWKS flow visualizer, RS256 verification, and RBAC enforcement.
author: Theekshana Sudeepa

scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
scripts.lint: npm --prefix backend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run lint
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run build && npm run test
